entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bernardo de Sá Nogueira de Figueiredo, 1st Marquess de Sá da Bandeira was a Portuguese nobleman and politician. He served as Prime Minister of Portugal for five times. He was the most prominent Portuguese defender of the abolition of slavery in Portugal and its domains, while also defending a modernized and expanded colonial empire.
